id.description: ID for the <table> element. Required for accessibility when using sticky headers or scrollable tables.

columns.description: Ordered column definitions; nested columns form grouped headers. Hidden columns are omitted from rendering.

align.description: Horizontal cell content alignment. Center also centers buttons and avatars.

verticalAlign.description: Vertical position of cell content; top is the default.

primary.description: Marks the primary column shown in stacked/responsive mode.

footer.description: Static footer content, or a React callback receiving visible rows.

className.description: Additional data-cell classes, including bg-* and text-* USX color utilities.

headerClassName.description: Additional header cell classes, including bg-* and text-* USX color utilities.

backgroundColor.description: Background color for data cells in this column.

color.description: Text color for data cells in this column.

headerBackgroundColor.description: Background color for this column header.

headerColor.description: Text color for this column header.

filterable.description: Include this column in client-side search.

searchValue.description: React-only text source for searching computed values.

stackLabel.description: Label for this cell in stacked layout.

sortValue.description: React-only comparable value serialized for the shared JS sorter.

data.description: Array of row data objects. Each row may set rowProps {backgroundColor, color, className} and cellProps keyed by column key with {rowSpan, colSpan, align, verticalAlign, backgroundColor, color, className}.

primaryKey.description: Property name used as the unique row identifier.

caption.description: Accessible caption for the data table.

searchable.description: Show a search field. Searches visible column values in React and rendered row text in Django/HTML.

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

scrollable.description: Wrap the table in a horizontally-scrollable container.

responsive.description: Below 480px, stack cells with labels; 'stack-header' shades the first data cell as each row's heading.

stickyHeader.description: Keep the header row visible while scrolling (usx-data-table--sticky-header).

stickyFirstColumn.description: Sticky-pin the first column on horizontal scroll.

sortable.description: Enable sorting on all columns (individual columns can opt out via column.sortable: false).

sort.description: Initial sort state: { key: string, direction: 'asc' | 'desc' | null }. Runtime changes are emitted as usx:data-table:sort events.

selectionMode.description: Row selection mode. 'checkbox' enables multi-select; 'radio' enables single-select.

selectionVerticalAlign.description: Vertical position of selection checkboxes and radios. They are centered horizontally.

select.description: Initially selected primary key values. Runtime changes are emitted as usx:data-table:select events.

allowSelectAll.description: Show 'select all' checkbox in header (checkbox mode only).

disabled.description: Array of primary key values for rows that should be non-interactive.

groupBy.description: Group rows by a property. String shorthand or object: { property, expand, defaultExpanded, headers, columns, rowClassName, values }. headers defines an optional top band; columns defines group-row cells. Both sets of colSpans must cover visible data columns. rowClassName accepts bg-* and text-* USX utilities.

rowDetails.description: Expandable row details. React accepts a render callback; Django uses rowDetailField with rowDetails enabled.

showFooter.description: Render a <tfoot> row using column.footer or column.aggregate values.

paginate.description: Client-side pagination with pageSize and pageSizeOptions. totalCount enables server-side paging via usx:data-table:page-change events.

loading.description: Show a loading state overlay. Does not affect interactivity.

placeholder.description: Content shown when the data array is empty.

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the <table> element.

expandedRows.description: Django only. List of primary-key values whose detail rows are open on initial render. Mirrors the React rowDetails.expand controlled prop.

rowDetailTemplate.description: Django only. Path to a Django partial template rendered as row-detail content (replaces React rowDetails.render).

rowDetailField.description: Django only. Key in each row dict whose value is used as inline row-detail content (simpler alternative to rowDetailTemplate).

rowUrlField.description: Django only. Key in each row dict holding the navigation URL for clickable rows (replaces React onClickRow). The block-link CSS pattern is used; no JS required.

children.description: Composed table sections, replacing the generated table sections (React only).

django.description: The Django template does not consume children.

infinite.description: Render a sentinel that emits usx:data-table:more when it enters the viewport.

clickableRows.description: Make rows keyboard and pointer activatable; the JS initializer emits usx:data-table:row-activate.

extraAttributes.description: Additional HTML attributes on the table shell.
